title: Very flashy and full of extra decorations that don't mix with a house cat
text: Very flashy and full of extra decorations that don't mix with a house cat. Well, this is ok and it is definitely big enough to be used under a large Christmas tree. However, it's just way too busy and bedazzled for my taste. In person there's a lot more going on than in the pictures. Sparkles, glitter, and a weird, fake fur trim glued to outside edge. It's an open invitation to our cat to come wreak havoc. I think we will just go back to our simple red skirt and call it good.
